hikes.name: Carroll Rim (Painted Hills)
hikes.blurb: A short climb to a rimrock view straight down on the red, gold and black stripes of the Painted Hills.

hikes.name: Painted Cove
hikes.blurb: A boardwalk loop through crumbly red claystone hills up close.

hikes.name: Steins Pillar
hikes.blurb: Through ponderosa forest to the base of a 350-foot rhyolite tower in the Ochocos.

hikes.name: Lookout Mountain (Ochoco)
hikes.blurb: Up through aspen and open flats to a high plateau with the Cascades lined up on the western horizon.

hikes.name: Twin Pillars
hikes.blurb: Up Mill Creek through the Mill Creek Wilderness to two volcanic spires.

hikes.name: Round Mountain
hikes.blurb: From Round Mountain North Trailhead, an 8.4-mile round trip to the top of Round Mountain (6,738 ft), with about 1,900 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Duncan Butte
hikes.blurb: From Lookout Mountain Lower Trailhead, a 6.5-mile round trip to the top of Duncan Butte (5,540 ft), with about 1,850 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Sutton Mountain
hikes.blurb: From Sutton Mountain Trailhead, a 6.6-mile round trip to the top of Sutton Mountain (4,615 ft), with about 1,600 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Blue Basin Overlook
hikes.blurb: From Blue Basin Parking, a 3.0-mile round trip to Blue Basin Overlook, with about 800 feet of climbing.
